contract.viewDescription: This is the official preview of the Electronic Publishing Contract. You can download the PDF at any time for legal record-keeping.
contract.document.preamble: This Software Publishing Contract (the "Contract") is made and becomes effective on the date the final representative completes the electronic signature on the GodotLaunch system. The contract is voluntarily agreed upon by the parties below:
contract.document.section2BodyPrefix: Party B represents and warrants that it is the sole lawful owner of the interactive video game product titled "{{title}}". The collaboration model selected by the parties is:
contract.document.section3CoPublishingIn: The parties agree to jointly operate and share revenue earned from commercializing the Game, after deducting applicable taxes and third-party payment gateway fees, according to the following ratio:
contract.document.section3CoPublishingPa: Party A is responsible for automatically settling Party B's revenue share into Party B's Godot Launch electronic wallet immediately after each successful game sale transaction is completed.
contract.document.section3FullAcquisitio: Party B agrees to permanently and irrevocably transfer all copyright, authorship rights, source code, graphic and audio assets, and all commercial rights relating to the Game to Party A from the Effective Date.
Party A shall pay Party B a one-time lump-sum amount of {{amount}}. After receiving payment, Party B agrees that it will have no further claims for revenue sharing or copyright arising from the Game.
contract.document.section4OwnershipBody: Under the co-publishing model, Party B retains intellectual property ownership of the Game while Party A receives digital publishing rights on the platform. Under the full acquisition model, intellectual property ownership transfers fully and permanently to Party A from the moment the contract is signed.
contract.document.section4Confidentialit: Both parties undertake to keep confidential all technical information, commercial data, the Game's source code, and the content of this Contract. Neither party may copy, provide, or disclose such information to any third party without the other party's prior written consent.
contract.document.section4NoResaleLabel: 4.3 Commitment not to resell or redistribute source code:
contract.document.section4NoResaleCoPubl: For the co-publishing model: Party B shall not sell, distribute, or license the Game's source code or original assets to any other platform, third party, or competitor without Party A's prior written consent.
contract.document.section4NoResaleFullAc: For the full acquisition model: Exclusive copyright and ownership of the source code belong to Party A. Party B is strictly prohibited from using, copying, distributing, transferring, or selling the Game's source code to any other individual or organization in any form.
contract.document.section4OriginalityBod: Party B guarantees that the Game and all of its constituent resources, including source code, images, audio, and design, are original creative works of Party B and do not copy, plagiarize, steal ideas from, or infringe upon the intellectual property rights of any other individual or organization.
contract.document.section4ViolationIntro: If Party B is found, or is accused or reported by a third party, to have infringed intellectual property rights, copied illegally, sold source code without authorization, or breached confidentiality obligations:
contract.document.section4ViolationItem1: Party B shall bear full legal responsibility and compensate Party A and related parties for all actual losses and damages incurred.
contract.document.section4ViolationItem2: Party A has the right to unilaterally terminate the Contract immediately, remove the Game from the Godot Launch platform, suspend Party B's wallet account, and retain all unpaid wallet balance or revenue to resolve disputes or offset damages.
contract.document.section5ValidityBody: This Contract becomes effective on the date representatives of both parties complete the electronic signature on the Godot Launch system and remains in force until it is lawfully terminated or all related obligations have been fulfilled.
contract.document.section5DisputeFallbac: Any dispute arising out of or relating to this Contract shall first be resolved through good-faith negotiation. If no resolution is reached, the dispute shall be submitted to the digital dispute resolution center within the Godot Launch system or to a competent arbitration body in accordance with applicable regulations.
